name: SQL-Cheatsheet
description: Durchsuchbare Referenz für SQL-Syntax — SELECT, JOIN, Filter, Aggregation, DDL, Fensterfunktionen, Transaktionen.

strings.Quick reference for SQL syntax, searchab: Kurzreferenz für SQL-Syntax, durchsuchbar nach Kategorie oder Stichwort.
strings.SELECT col1 AS alias FROM table: SELECT spalte1 AS alias FROM tabelle
strings.SELECT col FROM table LIMIT n: SELECT spalte FROM tabelle LIMIT n
strings.SELECT col FROM table LIMIT n OFFSET m: SELECT spalte FROM tabelle LIMIT n OFFSET m
strings.SELECT col FROM table ORDER BY col ASC|D: SELECT spalte FROM tabelle ORDER BY spalte ASC|DESC
strings.SELECT col FROM table WHERE condition: SELECT spalte FROM tabelle WHERE bedingung
strings.SELECT a.* FROM a CROSS JOIN b: SELECT links.* FROM links CROSS JOIN rechts
strings.Anti-join (rows in a not in b): Anti-Join (Zeilen in a, die nicht in b sind)
strings.Match any of a set: Treffer bei einem Wert aus einer Menge
strings.WHERE col BETWEEN v1 AND v2: WHERE spalte BETWEEN v1 AND v2
strings.SELECT col, COUNT(*) FROM table GROUP BY: SELECT spalte, COUNT(*) FROM tabelle GROUP BY spalte
strings.SELECT col, SUM(amount) FROM table GROUP: SELECT spalte, SUM(betrag) FROM tabelle GROUP BY spalte
strings.SELECT col, AVG(price) FROM table GROUP: SELECT spalte, AVG(preis) FROM tabelle GROUP BY spalte
strings.SELECT col, MIN(col2), MAX(col2) FROM ta: SELECT spalte, MIN(spalte2), MAX(spalte2) FROM tabelle GROUP BY spalte
strings.SELECT col, GROUP_CONCAT(col2) FROM tabl: SELECT spalte, GROUP_CONCAT(spalte2) FROM tabelle GROUP BY spalte
strings.SELECT col, STRING_AGG(col2, \",\") FROM: SELECT spalte, STRING_AGG(spalte2, ",") FROM tabelle GROUP BY spalte
strings.INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v: INSERT INTO tabelle (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v2)
strings.INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) SELECT c1, c2: INSERT INTO tabelle (c1, c2) SELECT c1, c2 FROM andere
strings.INSERT INTO table (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v: INSERT INTO tabelle (c1, c2) VALUES (v1, v2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name: CREATE TABLE tabelle (id INT PRIMARY KEY, bezeichnung VARCHAR(255))
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PR: CREATE TABLE tabelle (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY)
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY): CREATE TABLE tabelle (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY)
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY A: CREATE TABLE tabelle (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)
strings.CREATE TABLE t (id INT, FOREIGN KEY (id): CREATE TABLE tabelle (id INT, FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES andere(id))
strings.ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN col VARCHAR(100: ALTER TABLE tabelle ADD COLUMN spalte VARCHAR(100)
strings.ALTER TABLE t DROP COLUMN col: ALTER TABLE tabelle DROP COLUMN spalte
strings.ALTER TABLE t RENAME COLUMN old TO new: ALTER TABLE tabelle RENAME COLUMN alt TO neu
strings.CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx ON table(col): CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx ON tabelle(spalte)
strings.WITH cte AS (SELECT ...) SELECT * FROM c: WITH hilfstabelle AS (SELECT ...) SELECT * FROM hilfstabelle
strings.WITH RECURSIVE cte AS (...) SELECT * FRO: WITH RECURSIVE hilfstabelle AS (...) SELECT * FROM hilfstabelle
strings.SELECT col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY: SELECT spalte, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY spalte) FROM tabelle
strings.SELECT col, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g: SELECT spalte, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY spalte) FROM tabelle
strings.SELECT col, LAG(col) OVER (ORDER BY col): SELECT spalte, LAG(spalte) OVER (ORDER BY spalte) FROM tabelle
strings.SELECT col, LEAD(col) OVER (ORDER BY col: SELECT spalte, LEAD(spalte) OVER (ORDER BY spalte) FROM tabelle
strings.SELECT col, FIRST_VALUE(col) OVER (PARTI: SELECT spalte, FIRST_VALUE(spalte) OVER (PARTITION BY g) FROM tabelle
strings.SELECT CASE WHEN c1 THEN v1 ELSE v2 END: SELECT CASE WHEN c1 THEN v1 ELSE v2 END FROM tabelle
strings.SELECT COALESCE(col1, col2, default) FRO: SELECT COALESCE(spalte1, spalte2, standard) FROM tabelle
strings.MERGE INTO target USING source ON condit: MERGE INTO ziel USING quelle ON bedingung WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE ...
strings.SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COM: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
